sentences.text: No: for a floating rate loan granted to an individual for purposes other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026. [R1]
The UCB directions apply to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and this loan was sanctioned on 1 March 2026. [E8]
The earlier RBI pre-payment charge direction for floating rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes was superseded, while the current UCB direction is in force. [E1,E7,E9]
